title: Nice product, but has a few sharp edges
text: Nice product, but has a few sharp edges. Because it is cast iron, we found that the hooks themselves had some, small jagged points that snag the items you hang on it. Took out a metal file and removed those and now it's fine. But not before it created some problems for the sweaters and jackets I originally hung on it.
